name: milan-cathedral
description: Candoglia marble Gothic cathedral with measured five-aisle plan, flying buttresses, stepped terraces, traced glazed openings, sculptural pinnacles and gilded Madonnina.

placement_evidence.anchor: mapped main spire centre; axis fitted to the long nave roof edge
placement_evidence.base: 128.5m production datum from open southwest piazza; roof-contaminated source centre is144.94m and is locally cut
placement_evidence.piazza_ground: references/sacred/milan-piazza-ground.json; the mapped open forecourt is capped at the entry datum, preserving lower measured ground and retaining ordinary buildings and paths

interpretive_details: Primary plan is surveyed. Small carvings and secondary pinnacle heights are simplified; mapped roof-part height estimates are replaced by the Fabbrica terrace measurements. The complete135-spire inventory remains to be reconciled with a roof plan.
geometry: original metric geometry authored for Low Poly Earth from cited architectural references
